description: Input event sequence for Kotoba Multilingual Speech-to-Text (STT) Streaming (kotoba-multilingual-stt-streaming v1.0), SageMaker bidirectional streaming

events._comment: Step 1: Configure session after receiving transcription_session.created (within 60 s of connecting)
Step 2: Send audio chunks (80ms recommended, max 8 seconds per event). event_id: up to 36 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -
Step 3: Signal end of audio stream. event_id is optional and is returned as item_id on input_audio_buffer.committed

opus.description: Self-contained Ogg/Opus blob per append event, decoded at 48 kHz

audio_format_specs._notes: Any positive input_audio_sample_rate is accepted for pcm16 and float32 and resampled server-side; 24000 is recommended. PCM input with more than one channel is downmixed to mono.

turn_detection_options._comment: session.turn_detection accepts false, a semantic VAD object (recommended) or a server VAD object
turn_detection_options._notes: With false there is no automatic turn detection — concatenate delta events and use input_audio_buffer.committed as the done signal. With a VAD object the server emits a conversation.item.input_audio_transcription.completed event at each detected turn boundary. semantic_vad (recommended): eagerness low, medium, high or auto (= medium); a turn ends sooner after a finished sentence. server_vad: silence_duration_ms (default 800) is the time without text output that ends a turn. Semantic VAD ends a turn soon after a sentence is complete and waits longer while it is not; server VAD ends a turn after every pause of silence_duration_ms, which can split a phone number or an address that is read with pauses. For dictated numbers and addresses, use semantic VAD or a longer silence_duration_ms. Tune for your application and downstream pipeline.
